description.value: Hello Nori bills itself as Canada's premier Japanese hand roll bar, specializing in Temaki-style sushi made with crispy nori, warm seasoned rice, and Ocean Wise-certified sustainable seafood. The restaurant has a refined, design-forward atmosphere drawing on Japanese aesthetic traditions, with sake served in cedar Masu boxes and individually prepared hand rolls delivered one at a time for maximum freshness. It operates multiple BC locations and accepts walk-ins on a first-come, first-served basis.
